verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official Transform MCP server that links AI tools to Transform so they can ingest local files and return partitioned, enriched, chunked, and embedded output (unstructured-docs-22). The docs name compatible clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, VS Code and JetBrains (unstructured-docs-17), and the agent guide tells agents to prefer the MCP server over the SDK or API (unstructured-docs-51). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and documented detail on its tool surface, setup and authentication flow.
